sources.title: RolanDorisTech/Qwen3.8-4B-Distill-MLX-oQ8e · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MLX-native quantized version of Qwen3.8-4B-Distill, built with oMLX Universal Dynamic Quantization (oQe). Standard mlx-lm safetensors — works with mlx-lm, oMLX, LM Studio, and mlx-swift.

sources.snippet: Welcome to the GitHub repository of the Qwen3.5 open model series, including Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and the latest Qwen3.8. Here, you can find official information about Qwen3.8, post your questions (Issues), and share your ideas with the community (Discussions).

sources.title: empero-ai/Qwen3.8-2B-Distill · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-2B is a full-parameter distillation of Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B into the Qwen3.5-2B architecture — the smallest member of the family, trained on the same curriculum as its larger siblings.

sources.snippet: Think of distillation like condensing a giant 1,000-page encyclopedia into a pocket-sized cheat sheet. The Teacher Model (Qwen3.8-2.4T): A massive AI running on multi-million dollar data centers. It generates step-by-step reasoning solutions ("Chain of Thought").
